newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta breaks 84.00, market tests intervention.
newsitem.headline: Peseta breaks 84.00, market tests intervention.

text.p: The peseta broke key resistance at 84.00 per mark to hit the highest level since May on Thursday.
Traders saw the peseta's rise in the morning as a test of the Bank of Spain's willingness to enter the market.
"The market is pushing the peseta higher and can see that the Bank of Spain is not intervening, which is encouraging further moves higher," said one trader.
"After 84.00, the next key level is 83.80," he added.
By 1200 GMT, the peseta was trading at 83.87/89 compared with levels seen in early trade around 84.11/14 and late Wednesday's levels of 84.10/12.
